name: Waterford Bath Rug
description:
Waterford bath rugs are made from 100% cotton. Soft underfoot, quick to absorb water and easy to care for.

Choose from 10 sizes in 19 colors.
features: Soft and Plush Texture: Our bath rug is designed with your comfort in mind, boasting a plush and inviting texture that pampers your feet with every step. Sink into its luxurious softness after a bath or shower, transforming your bathroom into a spa-like oasis.

Non-Slip Spray Latex Backing: Safety is paramount. Our bath rug features a non-slip backing that securely grips various flooring surfaces, including tile, hardwood, and linoleum. You can confidently step onto it without worrying about accidents.

Durability and Easy Maintenance: Built to withstand daily use, our bath rug is both durable and low-maintenance. It can handle the traffic of a busy bathroom and is easy to clean, ensuring it retains its quality over time.
